findings.F1: The book's losses come from shallow 5-day falls. Its 18 trades entered after a 5-day return between -5 % and -2 % lost 3.27 % each on average (−58.9 % summed). Its 22 trades entered after a 5-day fall deeper than 10 % earned 5.84 % each (+128.4 % summed). The profile's grid cases say the same over 5 days: deeper than −10 % gives an unusual move of +17.9 % (n 11, t 3.08), −10 % to −5 % gives +13.6 % (n 6, t 3.17), and −2 % to 0 % gives −6.9 % (n 3, t −2.39).
findings.F2: The size of the book's bet sorts its trades in order. The smallest third of entry |forecast| lost 1.90 % per trade (−49.4 % summed), the middle third earned 1.12 %, and the largest third earned 3.97 % (+103.3 %), over 26, 27 and 26 trades.
findings.F3: The deepest fall is −2.29 %, lasting 469 days from the peak in w9 to the trough in w13. With a yearly return of +2.4 %, it alone puts Calmar at 0.71, under 0.75. Inside it, trades lost −14.0 % summed in w11 and −56.6 % in w12. The losing trades of w12 and w17 had entered after a mean 5-day return of −6.0 %, the winners after −17.2 % (22 against 5 trades).
findings.F4: The book trades too little because a close in the top quarter of the range is rare. Only 4.4 % of grid bars are in the profile, and the book holds a position on 4 % of coin-days, with 79 trades (0.0096 trades per day). Widening the close to anywhere in the upper half of the range, after a negative 5-day return, more than doubles the 5-day cases (22 against 9) with a larger unusual move: +12.1 % (t 3.35) against +8.5 % (t 1.79). The added band, a close between 0.5 and 0.75 of the range, alone gives +14.6 % (n 13, t 2.81).
findings.F5: A deep fall without a high close is not the effect, so the depth of the fall is a valid grade of this idea, not an idea of its own.
findings.F6: The effect lives in the choppy agitated profile.

ideas.idea: In a choppy, agitated market, when a coin's daily close sits in the upper part of that day's high-low range after its 5-day return has been negative, its price falls over the next five days, and the deeper that 5-day fall, the larger the fall.
ideas.consequence: In a range-bound, agitated market, a trader shorts any close that sits high in its day's range after a 5-day fall, not only a close pinned at the high, and shorts more the deeper the fall, so the book trades more often and puts little on shallow falls, which were the trades that lost.
ideas.name: upper close after deep fall

ideas.idea: In a choppy, agitated market, when a coin's daily close sits near the top of that day's high-low range after its 5-day return has been negative, its price falls over the next five days, and the fall grows with the depth of that 5-day fall, a shallow 5-day fall being followed by only a small one.
ideas.consequence: In a range-bound, agitated market, a trader sizes the short on a high close by how far the coin fell over the past five days, so the shallow-fall trades that made the book's deepest fall carry little weight.
ideas.name: high close fall-depth graded
